status: Conditional spatial-source experiment fixed after the endpoint1M population response, before line reobservation
endpoint_batch_rule: batch b is the UNION [8200000000+1000*b,8200000000+1000*(b+1)) and [8200100000+9000*b,8200100000+9000*(b+1)); preserve prior nested source batches rather than contiguous 10000 rebatching

dependency_groups.name_boundary: Historical ID retained; current endpoint marks cover the same nested1M union as the saved source result
Historical ID retained; current endpoint marks cover the same nested1M union as the saved source result

readout: R=I[ambient black homology rank1], O4=(vx+i*vy)^4/(vx^2+vy^2)^2 for any nonzero physical closed-cycle lift v. O4 is sign/multiple invariant. Store R,R*s,R*ReO4,R*ImO4,R*s*ReO4,R*s*ImO4 at every K, with bulk s=CB+CW.
geometry_frame: The original physical square-lattice x/y frame in both geometries, never raw period-basis winding coordinates. Primitive cyclic and integer HNF backends keep their original quotient labels and RNG.
semantic_identity: In the same required forward/backward sweeps, ambient rank equals I[K>=K_minus]+I[K>=K_plus]; its rank1 support is [K_minus,K_plus). This is an in-run observation identity, not a second simulation/test suite.
conditioning: Normalize inside each geometry first: mu=<R*O4>/<R>; then form fixed first-minus-second or exact Delta cos4 projections. No source-dependent mixture weights.
root: Reuse current central and aligned delete-one pooled matching roots saved in source_result. Integrate old q/E profiles and new conditional line profiles at each supplied root. No new root solver or independent root anchor.
source_response: C_s=<R*O4*s>/<R>-mu*<R*s>/<R>; mu_p=(<R*O4>_p-mu*<R>_p)/<R>; nu_s=C_s+pdot_s*mu_p. Bulk source throughout; no second factor N.
primary_named_model: s ~ a_g+b_N*K+d_N*E to first order, E=q^2. Geometry-common b_N,d_N, allowed to vary with N. alpha_E=rdot_s/rdot_E comes from root-comoving pooled rank1 population. pred_E=alpha_E*pdot_E*mu_p where pdot_E=-mean(q*(1-E))/mean(q_p). Include root transport.
primary_residual: Four real components of nu_s-pred_E per N; preserve all components and joint cross-N covariance. Paired real/imaginary P4 projections are correlated summaries, not new independent experiments.
broader_named_model: s ~ a_g+b_N*K+c_N*q+d_N*E with common real b,c,d. Inside rank1, q=E=0; hence four-real C_s must be parallel to mu_p with multiplier b*p*(1-p). Save all six unnormalized wedges C_i*T_j-C_j*T_i, using T=mu_p.
wedge_score: Save full eight-real (C,T) and six-wedge same-batch covariance. At regular null T!=0, use null-tangent Omega=L_T Cov(C-bhat*T) L_T^T, bhat=(T dot C)/(T dot T); supported rank at most3, never automatically6df. Small/noisy T weakens identification; compatibility is not closure. Distinguish within-geometry and cross-geometry wedges.
uncertainty: Delete each of100 aligned batches in line and source together; propagate saved root, root motion, alpha, conditional ratios and complex coordinates jointly. First4 sizes share one dependency group; endpoint original seeds retain separate groups. Do not sum source/line/E/wedge views as independent evidence.
wedge_weak_identification_rule: When norm(T)/sqrt(trace Cov(T))<3, retain raw C,T/minors and uncertainty but do not present a regular-null wedge p as resolved source closure. This pre-observation descriptive rule does not select more samples or suppress the primary E residual.
normalization: Only exact Delta cos4=1152/845 for N65/130/260 and2304/1445 for N85/170/340; no freely fitted exponent or selected quadrature.
acquisition: One deterministic reobservation of NEW line/source products on2.4M already source-marked old permutations across six sizes. Zero new Monte Carlo counters, no endpoint increment, no servers/GPU, no test suite. Both paired geometries and all K are correlated configurations of each permutation.
report: Repository JSON plus Markdown technical summary, definitions, actual finite conditional responses, model residuals, full covariance, uncertainty and next mechanism-discriminating action. Exact component lookup is textual/JSON; no separate dashboard or rendering pipeline. A compatibility result does not identify an energy field, establish continuum scaling or prove a microscopic source equality.
